type:
@Roth.degreeOf_none_rename_mul_aeval : ∀ {τ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {U : MvPolynomial τ R},
  U ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (V : Polynomial R),
      MvPolynomial.degreeOf none ((MvPolynomial.rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X none)) V) =
        V.natDegree
